verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 2 — all activities 'Within scope'
verdicts.reason: All receival, cleaning, storage, sampling and dispatch activities fall within the registered malting barley export operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 3 — 'no conditions, suspensions or reviews'
verdicts.reason: Registration is declared active with no suspension against the operations, though the lapsed 7 Aug 2024 expiry is a lesser concern outside the scope of suspension.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 5; Track 5 sec 1
verdicts.reason: The registered export area (14.0 ha Lot 10 DP 258621) is delineated with site plan.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 6; Track 5 sec 2
verdicts.reason: Buildings, facilities, services and adjoining sites are described in detail.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 sec 5; Track 1 sec 7
verdicts.reason: Layout of export-operation areas, permanent fixtures and equipment is documented on the site plan.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 9
verdicts.reason: No notifiable changes occurred and the notification obligation under Rule 4-6 is acknowledged.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 10
verdicts.reason: No alterations carried out; approval process for future alterations acknowledged.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 2-4; Track 1 sec 6
verdicts.reason: Establishment has the required buildings, equipment, facilities and services for grain export.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 4.2 — 550/440/418 lux LED
verdicts.reason: Adequate lighting installed with annual lux verification.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 4.3 — 'No handwashing facilities within or directly adjacent to the processing area'
verdicts.reason: Only a single cold-water basin at a toilet 115 m away; no handwashing at the processing area fails the requirement.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 5.1 cleanability
verdicts.reason: Smooth epoxy floors, FRP linings and stainless internals allow effective cleaning.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 5.2
verdicts.reason: Sealed junctions, mesh louvres, self-closing sealed doors and serviced roller-door seals minimise pest harbourage.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 5.3 waste disposal design
verdicts.reason: Bunded sump, sealed lidded bins and roofed/bunded waste bay provide hygienic waste disposal design.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 building schedule 'IB DAFF Inspection Room'; Track 5 sec 7
verdicts.reason: A dedicated enclosed DAFF inspection room and sampling facilities are provided.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4/5 — rotary screen cleaner and aspirator
verdicts.reason: Screening equipment manages the risk of large contaminants.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 sec 5 — 'cleaned by rotary screen and aspirator'
verdicts.reason: Cleaning/screening removes large contaminants prior to storage.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 Hygiene & Sanitation Plan
verdicts.reason: Comprehensive documented hygiene control system with master cleaning schedule and SOPs.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 6 EWMP v3.0 waste management system
verdicts.reason: A dedicated Establishment Waste Management Plan documents all waste streams and disposal, though the HACCP (Track 2) omits waste.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 + Track 4 sec 6
verdicts.reason: The hygiene and waste control systems are documented and appropriate for grain export operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 — 21 mapped bait stations with weekly/twice-weekly servicing schedule and CAPA
verdicts.reason: A mapped rodent bait-station system with a servicing schedule exists, satisfying the presence of a pest control system.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 sec 7 'effectiveness cannot be demonstrated'; Track 3 cover 'ad-hoc, no written SOP, risk assessment or scheduled treatment program'
verdicts.reason: The pest system's effectiveness is not demonstrable — no formal SOP/risk assessment or documented monitoring/corrective-action program.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 pest log 2022-2025; Track 6 records kept 2 years
verdicts.reason: At least two years of hygiene/waste/pest records are retained.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 note 'Language: English'; dated entries
verdicts.reason: Records are in English, dated and legible.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 sec 7.1; Track 6 sec 11
verdicts.reason: All areas assessed clean and hygienic at most recent inspection with current cleaning logs.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 Establishment Condition — 'None detected'; Track 4 sec 7.2 nil evidence
verdicts.reason: No pest evidence across all inspected areas; goods not likely infested.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 Bait Station Register 'Good'; Track 7 all stations 'Good'
verdicts.reason: Bait stations and traps are recorded as fit for purpose and in good working order.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 sec 4 — 'Temporary overflow pesticide cartons held in open shelf area during stocktake'
verdicts.reason: Pesticide stored on open shelving is improper chemical storage creating a contamination risk to prescribed goods.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 sec 4 — 'Chemical storage physically separated from export product handling and preparation areas'
verdicts.reason: Chemical storage is stated to be physically separated from preparation areas.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 1 Receival Register — property/paddock IDs
verdicts.reason: Traceability from source property/paddock to receival is recorded.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 2 Product Movement Log
verdicts.reason: Internal movement and lot integrity while at the establishment is tracked.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 4 Dispatch/Transfer Dockets — destination premises and RE No.
verdicts.reason: Transfer to next premises is recorded with destination and seal details.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 (labelling, lot codes, records); Track 2 sec 8 traceability system
verdicts.reason: Documented labelling and record-keeping controls maintain traceability and integrity.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 sec 2 — 'Flow chart omits one alternate transfer path used during peak receival periods'
verdicts.reason: The product flow chart is incomplete, omitting an actual transfer path.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 sec 9 'No formal failed goods procedure'; Track 9 Sheet 6 'blending rationale logged in shift note only'
verdicts.reason: No documented failed-goods control procedure for segregation/re-testing/downgrade/notification; blending only in an informal shift note.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 sec 1/5 — security zoning, sealed storage, pre-load inspections, separated hold/reject area
verdicts.reason: The phytosanitary security procedure provides contamination/infestation-risk controls, though HACCP (Track 2) lacks them.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 sec 3 — 'Substitution controls rely on single-operator checks for selected late-shift dispatches'
verdicts.reason: Single-operator dispatch verification is inadequate to minimise the risk of substitution.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 sec 4 — packaging/containment checks verify cleanliness, integrity and correct labels
verdicts.reason: Packaging/containment checks are documented before release.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 7 — '2-year retention verified' for receival/movement/dispatch and treatment records
verdicts.reason: Traceability records retention meets the two-year requirement per the archive register.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 7 — 'Rejected-goods attachments partly offsite'; Sheet 6 blending in shift note only
verdicts.reason: Failed/rejected-goods records are incompletely retained/retrievable (attachments partly offsite, blending rationale only in a shift note).

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 — all registers in English with dates
verdicts.reason: Traceability records are in English, dated, legible and auditable.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 sec 11 — UK phyto cert, import permit, MRL, fumigation; Track 9 treatment records
verdicts.reason: Importing-country (UK) requirements are documented and supported by fumigation/treatment records.
